This guide holds Hartgen Consultancy’s own documentation, gathered on 28 September 2026, for the products it makes for JAWS users: Leasey, J-Say, the Zoom Professional Scripts and the StationPlaylist scripts.

The Leasey manual is the bulk of it, one page per feature. The announcement posts are kept because Hartgen documents each release in them rather than in a changelog. The shop, the basket and the same posts served as programming data are left out.

About Hartgen Consultancy

About Hartgen Consultancy

Welcome to Hartgen Consultancy, a premier provider of JAWS screen reader expertise. Our mission is to empower individuals and organizations to break down digital barriers, enabling smoother, more productive interactions with technology. We bring an unparalleled level of experience and dedication to adaptive technology, specializing in JAWS training and script writing.

At Hartgen Consultancy, our passion for accessibility drives us to provide the highest quality support for those navigating the digital world with JAWS. Whether you’re looking to enhance your personal productivity or create an inclusive workplace, we’re here to deliver the skills, solutions, and insights to help you achieve these goals.

Our Journey.

Founded with a commitment to accessibility and empowerment, Hartgen Consultancy has grown from a small initiative into a leading force in the adaptive technology sector. The consultancy was built on the belief that everyone deserves equal access to information and digital resources, and this principle has guided our growth and focus. From the beginning, we saw a need for high-quality, personalized training in JAWS and adaptive technology, as well as expertly crafted scripting services that tailor the user experience for blind and visually impaired individuals.

Our founder’s background in both technology and accessibility provided the perfect foundation for Hartgen Consultancy. By combining deep technical skills with a user-centered approach, we set out to deliver not only technical excellence but also an understanding of what users truly need to succeed. Today, Hartgen Consultancy serves a global client base and is recognized as a trusted name in JAWS training, scripting, and adaptive technology consulting.

What We Offer.

Our offerings are designed to cater to both individuals and organizations, ensuring everyone can harness the power of technology with confidence. Below are some of the core services we provide.

JAWS Training.

We believe that learning to use JAWS should be an empowering experience. Our training programs are crafted to provide learners with hands-on experience, enabling them to gain a comprehensive understanding of JAWS functionality, shortcuts, and advanced features. Whether you are new to JAWS or looking to refine your skills, our training sessions are tailored to each user’s knowledge level, learning pace, and specific goals.

Our trainers are seasoned experts who use JAWS daily and understand the practical challenges users may face. By focusing on real-world applications and interactive exercises, we aim to make our training as relevant and beneficial as possible. Each course can be delivered in a one-on-one format, group setting, or even remotely for added flexibility.

JAWS Scripting.

The hallmark of Hartgen Consultancy is our exceptional JAWS scripting expertise. JAWS scripts are powerful tools that can transform the way you interact with software, providing customized accessibility and productivity enhancements. Our script writing service is geared toward creating solutions that simplify complex tasks, automate repetitive actions, and ensure seamless software integration for blind and visually impaired users.

We develop scripts tailored to your specific needs, whether you’re looking to streamline workplace tasks, improve access to commonly used applications, or create custom keyboard shortcuts for frequently performed actions.

Need to make a particular software accessible? Our scripts can adapt even complex applications for ease of use with JAWS, enabling smoother interactions and greater independence.

As applications evolve, so must the scripts that support them. We offer ongoing script maintenance and updates to ensure compatibility with software changes and upgrades, so your accessibility solutions remain seamless and reliable.

Hartgen Consultancy’s script writing has been recognized for its reliability, precision, and user-centered approach. We work closely with clients to understand their unique needs, developing solutions that are practical, efficient, and designed to make a tangible difference.

Innovative Resources and Community Support.

In addition to our core services, Hartgen Consultancy is committed to providing valuable resources and support to the wider adaptive technology community. We create tutorials, webinars, and publications that cover everything from JAWS tips and tricks to troubleshooting advice and industry insights. Our goal is to foster a supportive community where technology users, trainers, and developers can learn, share, and grow together.

Why Choose Hartgen Consultancy?

When you work with Hartgen Consultancy, you’re choosing a partner who is committed to delivering excellence, accessibility, and empowerment through every interaction. Here’s what sets us apart:

  • Depth of Expertise: With years of experience in adaptive technology and accessibility, our team brings a wealth of knowledge that ensures high-quality, effective solutions tailored to your needs.
  • Personalized Approach: We recognize that each client is unique, and we approach every project with a focus on customization, collaboration, and understanding.
  • Commitment to Quality: Our clients rely on us for solutions that are reliable, robust, and designed to provide lasting value. We’re dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of quality in everything we do.
  • Focus on Practicality: Accessibility shouldn’t be complicated. We prioritize simple, practical solutions that fit into your daily workflow, making it easier for you or your team to leverage the full potential of JAWS and other tools.
  • Empowering Education: At the heart of Hartgen Consultancy is a passion for education and empowerment. We believe in providing not just services, but also the skills and knowledge to help you succeed long-term.

Client Success Stories.

Our clients come from diverse backgrounds, industries, and regions, each with unique goals and challenges. From individual users seeking to maximize their productivity to large organizations working to enhance workplace accessibility, Hartgen Consultancy has been instrumental in helping our clients achieve success. Here are just a few examples:

  • A university approached us to make their student portal accessible for visually impaired users. Through custom scripts and staff training, we enabled smoother access to course materials, enhancing the learning experience for students
  • A financial services company sought to improve workplace accessibility. We provided tailored JAWS scripts and training, equipping their visually impaired employees to work more independently and efficiently within complex software environments.
  • A public sector client needed support in achieving digital accessibility compliance. Our accessibility audit identified key areas for improvement, helping them meet accessibility standards and improve user experience for all users.

Join Us In Creating An Accessible Future.

Hartgen Consultancy is more than a business—it’s a community dedicated to making a difference. As we continue to grow and expand our offerings, we remain rooted in our commitment to accessibility, quality, and empowerment. Whether you’re an individual seeking to expand your skills, an organization striving to create an inclusive workplace, or simply someone passionate about accessibility, we invite you to join us on this journey.

We are here to help you navigate the challenges and opportunities of adaptive technology, providing the expertise, support, and personalized solutions you need to thrive in today’s digital world. Together, let’s create a future where everyone can access, interact with, and benefit from technology without barriers. Let’s work together to make technology more inclusive, empowering, and accessible for all.

Awards For Excellence!

On 29 October 2022, we were the recipient of the Pennsylvania Council of the Blind’s Community Impact Award for which we are both honoured and very grateful. This is the text which appears on the plaque of the award.

The Pennsylvania Council of the Blind, a Peer Network for All Impacted by Vision Loss, presents this 2022 Community Impact Award to Hartgen Consultancy.

Founded in 2014 by Brian and Louise Hartgen, Hartgen Consultancy was established with a mission to provide accessible training and usable software tools to individuals with vision loss and to the deaf Blind community. Its product offerings have and continue to significantly contribute to the employability and productivity of these communities. The Hartgens’ vision of inclusiveness and accessibility; a vision that informs every training module, all adaptive products, and excellent customer service, embodies the commitment to the core values of the company they have built. Hartgen Consultancy has rightfully earned an international reputation for integrity, innovation, principled design, and provision of product training, support, and troubleshooting.

Presented on October 29, 2022 at the 87th Annual PCB Conference and Convention

On 6 July 2023, we were presented with The Robert S. Bray Award by the American Council of the Blind. The Robert S. Bray Award is given in honour of the first director of what is now the National Library Service for the Blind and Physically Handicapped. This award may be given to an individual or an organization that has made a significant contribution to improving library services, information technology or communication access.

The text includes:

In recognition of outstanding commitment to making technology more accessible through training and scripting.

Hartgen Consultancy’s Immediate Future

Given this blog post is going to be distributed to multiple Email lists, it is likely some people will read it a number of times for which I apologise. I will also try to make it not too personal, but it is important that our loyal customers understand what is happening.

Four weeks ago, I was in perfect health, and I do mean perfect. However, I have since been diagnosed with an illness which at the moment is causing severe and ongoing pain in my legs. This is from the moment I wake in the morning. Fortunately, there are small periods throughout the day when the pain lessens, and it is at that point when I have been able to work and keep the business running.

The illness is being treated but that is causing extreme tiredness. So I have had to move from a position of doing a 12 or 14 hour work day to just a few hours.

All products are up-to-date as of this moment in terms of features and compatibility. The priority for September will be to deliver the two hours of outstanding training in relation to the AI training course. This will be done through two pre-recorded sessions rather than Zoom meetings, and will be distributed together with text transcripts as usual.

Technical support for products will of course be provided as quickly as it can be done.

I am hopeful that the coming weeks will give us a greater indication as to what the future might look like. But it is important to get the word out to the community in the event temporary hospitalisation is required.

Thank you for your understanding during this difficult time.

Courses and talks

AI Like That Series 3: Getting Creative

In 2024 and 2025, the first two series of AI Like That explored a wide range of AI tools and techniques — from writing prompts and describing images, to comparing documents and simplifying online shopping. We focused on popular tools including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and more.

Now, in Series 3, we’re taking things a step further — encouraging you to get creative with AI, both professionally and for pure enjoyment. We’ll also revisit some unfinished topics and look at the latest accessibility improvements across the platforms we’ve already explored.

What’s New in Series 3?

  • Introduction.
  • More on Effective Prompt Creation.
  • Using the ChatGPT Agent, Creating the Harry Potter Game.
  • Using the ChatGPT Agent, Designing a Complaint Letter.
  • Omni Describer.
  • ChatGPT5 Speed Tests.
  • More ChatGPT5 Improvements.
  • ChatGPT5 and Voice Mode.
  • ChatGPT’s Integration with GMail.
  • Separating Song Vocals and Instrumentals.
  • Introduction to CoPilot in Edge.
  • CoPilot and the Model Selector.
  • Submitting Prompts to CoPilot.
  • Talking With CoPilot.
  • Web Page Summaries.
  • The CoPilot App for Windows.
  • Introduction to Notebook LM.
  • Basic Orientation of Notebook LM.
  • Creating Our First Notebook.
  • Moving Through buttons Within a Notebook.
  • AI Audio Overview.
  • Generating Quizzes, Renaming and Deleting Notebooks.

Why Take This Course?

  • Gain hands-on, practical AI skills for work and play
  • Access full recordings and transcripts for review at your own pace

Course Details

  • Cost: £80 UK (approx. $107 US)
  • Duration: four hours. Alternatively an invoice can be sent to you which you can pay online.

Conclusion.

Whether you’ve joined us before or this is your first time, AI Like That – Series 3 is your chance to learn, experiment, and build with AI in a supportive, accessible environment. Let’s explore what you can create.

AI Like That!

Would you like:

  • A quick and easy way to check the weather or to get a summary of news headlines?
  • To translate text from one language to another effortlessly?
  • An analysis of a spreadsheet or document in seconds?
  • To check the spelling of a word with precision?
  • To summarise the content of an article or PDF if you’re in a hurry?
  • To compare products on shopping sites and find the best deal?
  • To draft emails, write reports, or even generate creative content like poems and stories. Your Personal Assistant called AI is here waiting for you!

AI technology is revolutionising our lives and this is just the beginning. Apart from assisting with all of the above subject areas and more, blind screen-reader users benefit in other ways:

  • Efficiency Boost. Even for the most proficient user of a screen-reader, tasks can take longer to achieve. AI can consolidate a lot of information which would otherwise take time to locate.

  • Image Descriptions. Descriptions of images using various tools can not only help to recapture past memories but in addition can assist in social media participation and group discussion. The training course, AI Like That, provides:

  • Thorough descriptions of AI tools and services, available at no cost and those requiring a subscription.

  • Screen-reading strategies you can use to gain access to many AI-related tools. This technology is changing on a weekly basis, so you need to know not only what AI can do, but how to work with changes so as to adapt your approach at a later time.

  • Language in which you can create your prompts to gain the best possible results if you are blind. As a screen-reader user, there are additional adaptations which can be made to enhance what is returned by AI.

  • How to customise your screen-reader so as to reach important parts of a page quickly, provide textual labels where they do not exist and to minimise spoken output if necessary. While this training course includes discussions of tools which you can use in the workplace, there is a heavy emphasis on how AI can be used for study and leisure pursuits.

AI Like That Series 1 contains over five hours of content. This was more than originally envisaged. Series 2 contained four hours of content.

Ready to dive in?

AI Like That can be purchased from this web site or by sending an Email to brian@hartgenconsultancy.com and requesting an invoice which can be paid by any major credit or debit card.

Purchase both series 1 and series 2. £140 or $182 US.

Conclusion.

While there may be some AI sceptics around, it is not only helping blind people to become more independent but it can save you plenty of time.

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to master AI technology and transform your daily tasks! Sign up for AI Like That and take the first step towards a more efficient and enjoyable digital experience. When the course is completed, you really will be saying, “Hey, I like that!”

Catching Up With JAWS Chapter 5!

Introduction.

Now is your chance to get some high quality training on some of the latest features within the screen-reader JAWS for Windows which have been introduced over the past three years. This follows on from our previous popular training courses on this subject. These training courses are still popular and people are purchasing the older volumes in the series even today!

If you are a person who chooses to upgrade your copy of JAWS on a regular basis, or maybe you’ve skipped an upgrade or two and you are about to update your computer to JAWS for Windows version 2026, chances are that you may not have had time to get to grips with the latest features the screen-reader offers. This is particularly relevant as of recent months. The JAWS licensing has changed even in the UK, and so it is important to bring people up to speed with the latest innovations. While JAWS does contain excellent documentation, there’s nothing like someone sitting down with you to explain how many of these new features work. Particularly in the last three years, Vispero have introduced some features which will both keep you informed and productive.

That’s why at Hartgen Consultancy, we’ve created a short course to enable you to get your JAWS knowledge up-to-date. The course focuses upon the new features included with JAWS versions 2024 through to 2026.

Purchasing JAWS is a significant investment, so it is important that you make the most of what you’ve paid for and that you are taught by someone who fully understands all aspects of using it. You may also be an access technology Trainer, or an I T Lecturer in a College who has a basic awareness of how JAWS works but again is not up to speed with the latest enhancements.

What You Will Learn.

This course has a duration of approximately two hours. It is designed for anyone who already understands how to use many functions of JAWS but who would like to gain a greater skill level with the latest features. The features are demonstrated with real world examples so that they make sense.

Each topic is contained within its own MP3 audio file and text document.

Topics include:

  • Why JAWS 2026 could be the best upgrade in recent years.
  • Using FSCompanion.
  • Announcing the Work Week.
  • Explaining the Early Adopter Programme.
  • The AI Labeler.
  • Changes in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word and Web Browsers.
  • New in JAWS 2026.
  • A very in depth look at Page Explorer.

How to Purchase.

Catching Up with JAWS is priced £35 which is approximately 45 American dollars.

Alternatively, anyone can purchase the course by sending an Email to jaws@hartgen.org, whereupon a fully accessible electronic invoice will be sent to you which can be paid through PayPal or any major credit or debit card.

Conclusion.

Be sure you are at the cutting edge of JAWS-based technology and become familiar with everything in the past three releases. You’ll be glad you did!

Training

Welcome to our JAWS Training Area!

Taking a course from you has been a stellar experience!

Your excellent teaching skills combined with your extensive knowledge of the subject make learning a pleasure.

You are methodical and articulate; your tag line (Training You Can Trust) accurately conveys exactly what you do.

Are you a user of the JAWS screen-reader but you need to learn more about how it works? You’ve come to the right place!

We offer Training Remotely to individuals, Ideal for Users Overseas. Our dedicated page linked to above fully describes our remote training service.

Finally, we have a range of training courses in the use of the JAWS for Windows screen-reader, either to learn how to use specific tools within the product, or in conjunction with popular programs. Even if you are proficient in the subject being covered, it is likely that you will pick up some useful tips and tricks along the way.

About the Training Courses.

Training courses are delivered using straightforward easy-to-understand language. Students access the course materials through a protected area of the Hartgen Consultancy website.

As software developers, we often come across situations where users have not had a good experience with the provided application because the Trainer has not had the necessary skills to teach the program. After all, a Trainer cannot inspire confidence in the student if he or she is not sufficiently experienced or prepared in the appropriate subject. Whether you are taking one of our online courses, or benefiting from our individual training programmes, we guarantee that thorough preparation is made prior to teaching the use of a software package to any student.

In summary, we would like you to learn, but have a great experience when learning how to use the program you have paid for!

Previous Training Courses.

By very popular request we have made archives of the following courses available. Included within each package is the audio lessons in MP3 format and text summaries where appropriate. However, opportunities do not exist for students to ask questions of the tutor or to seek advice upon specific points. We hope however that the knowledge gained while listening should be more than sufficient. Please bare this point in mind and refer to our Refund Policy.

Please bare in mind that software functionality changes on a rapid basis, so there are bound to be situations where the occasional procedure outlined in the audio archive does not function. J-Say

J-Say

Purchase the J-Say Training Course!

What is J-Say?

J-Say is the world leader in providing a blind person with the ability to control the computer with the human voice.

J-Say brings together Dragon NaturallySpeaking professional from Nuance, and JAWS For Windows from Vispero. However although the product integrates these applications, it also presents the User with an easy to understand interface enabling interaction with the computer using natural language and easy to remember and understand vocabulary.

That’s Good Terminology, But What Does it Actually Mean?

It’s quite simple. You can talk to the computer and it talks back to you. You can control most aspects of the computer just by using your voice, so J-Say is ideal for anyone who cannot (or does not want to use) the keyboard.

Who can use it?

As the product has evolved the range of people who are benefiting from the technology has increased. From people who simply want to be more productive and use their voice as an additional means of computer input and control, to individuals who have complex combinations of needs, and who find it difficult

if not impossible to make use of computer technology using traditionally accepted methods of input access and control.

Even more remarkably many people interacting with this technology do not have a visual impairment simply finding it difficult or uncomfortable to use the computer screen and so find the J-Say approach more suited to their needs.

Can I Not Use Dragon NaturallySpeaking and JAWS for Windows Without J-Say?

Please do try it. We would really like you to! Remember, do not touch the computer keyboard. Within a minute or two, you will soon discover it is an extremely frustrating experience. As you dictate text, it will not be echoed back. Try reading the current line of text; nothing will happen. Much of Dragon’s interface (including the Vocabulary Editor) will not be accessible.

In addition to our amazing J-Say features listed below, the product gives you:

  • Complete echo back of your dictation. This is essential so that, as a screen-reader user, you understand that the text you have dictated is accurately reproduced.
  • Complete voice access to all of the JAWS screen-reading functions.
  • Many features which have been specially designed for blind people who use voice recognition technology. With 20 years of experience working with individuals who cannot use the keyboard, we truly understand the features people need to ensure they are productive and not frustrated when using the computer in this way. Many of our productivity features go way beyond those which Dragon NaturallySpeaking offers to the sighted user.
  • Online help which fully explains how a blind person can independently install and use the software without sighted assistance. Our extremely comprehensive tutorial is designed with blind people in mind, and spoken context sensitive guidance is given in many areas of the program.

What applications does J-Say work with?

J-Say provides access to applications which reflect the most common things which people need to do with computers on a day-to-day basis.

Microsoft Word

Complete access to this application is made possible enabling people, without having to touch the keyboard or look at the screen, to create documents, control text layout and open/save files, amongst other things.

If you need to word process, doing it the J-Say way takes away the need to use either one’s hands or one’s eyes, do it all controlling the application with your voice and accessing the computer screen with your ears.

Microsoft Outlook

If you need to work with e-mail, J-Say provides you with a set of tools to enable you to take complete control of anything e-mail related. From creating messages to Email navigation, moving and copying messages to folders, to creating special voice commands to send messages to people quickly and easily. Our user interface to Microsoft Outlook provides the user with fast, efficient and effective access and control to all aspects of the application.

Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome or Brave

J-Say technology provides intuitive access to all aspects of internet navigation and control. From the finding, launching and browsing of WebPages, to the completion of web forms such as searches and shopping carts, J-Say provides the user with natural language internet access like never before.

What Else Can I Expect from J-Say?

  • Dictate text in a natural way and have it instantly echoed back to you.
  • Rapidly move through list items, words, lines, sentences and paragraphs and have the selected unit spoken back. No need to wait until JAWS has finished reciting the text, just speak the next command.
  • Use natural language commands to gain access to the many features of JAWS for Windows. For example, say the words “Be Quiet” to instantly silence the speech synthesiser, or “talk faster” and “talk slower” to change the rate of the speech.
  • Create J-Say Text Notes which can reproduce lengthy text passages (such as twenty paragraphs) with a single voice command.
  • Easily work with files using Microsoft File Explorer and J-Say Tags. Files and folders can be marked for cutting, copying or deleting.
  • Get the local weather or time zone for any city in the world or read the latest news from many sources.
  • Use the J-Say Clock to set countup and countdown timers and alarms, or hear Westminster Chimes throughout the day.
  • Quickly and easily search on Google, Wikipedia, Amazon, eBay, Youtube and a number of online library catalogues. Ideal for people who are learning to use the internet through to the experienced user. You can also search for, and play, podcast episodes courtesy of the iTunes Store from Apple.
  • Search your computer quickly for files, folder or internet favourites.
  • Keep track of appointments with J-Say Diary.
  • Move directly to specific sections of web pages with J-Say Alerts.
  • Listen to the radio, audio files or CD’s and control playback from within any program.
  • Manage many aspects of iTunes from Apple.
  • Dictate text into a portable recorder and have the audio transcribed as text with J-Say Audio Transcription support.
  • Chat with your colleagues using Microsoft Teams (Dragon 16 Only).
  • Take control of your Braille display. It is no longer necessary to remember the key combinations to control the Braille output. These commands will also prove to be a tremendous advantage to people who can read Braille, but who do not have the dexterity necessary to press buttons or keys on the unit.
  • Execute many commonly used procedures within the WINDOWS operating system with voice commands. Good examples would be to move directly to the WINDOWS
  • Desktop or to maximise the application and document windows, so that the program fills the entire screen.
  • Teach the software how you pronounce words and phrases with our interface which allows you to easily add them to the vocabulary. Our special utility can also be used by sighted assistants if necessary. Alternatively, use the superb access to the NaturallySpeaking Professional correction system.
  • The J-Say Configuration Wizard lets you take control of all the product’s special functions without the need to remember a number of voice commands.
  • Move through tables easily either within Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge or Microsoft Word. Again, the navigation language is simple to learn with no complications.
  • Use our slick Back-Up and restore utilities to make a permanent copy of your speech files and restore them at a later date if necessary.
  • And much much more including support for Microsoft Excel, Skype, Twitter, and Sonos audio devices.

Further Information about J-Say

J-Say can be customised to perform optimally with non-standard applications used in the workplace.

J-Say allows you to dictate text into almost any application and have the text echoed back. In the event that Dragon NaturallySpeaking itself is unable to communicate directly with the required program, the Dictation Box can be used. This is an environment where text can be dictated and edited before immediate transfer to the application. J-Say of course supports the Dictation Box.

Moreover if you are familiar with the many J-Say screen-reading commands, the chances of you being able to work with a non-standard application without the need for scripting are high.

You may also care to Purchase Training from us or your local J-Say Distributor.

Particularly when using the internet, it takes specialist knowledge to convey how JAWS functions alongside web pages and how you can use your voice to best effect so as not to make working with it an arduous process. If your intention is to browse the web with your voice, training is a very important consideration. Training can be delivered on site in the UK or remotely worldwide.

In terms of support, J-Say comes equipped with our extremely thorough documentation relating to installation and usage. Should a problem arise, we use a facility called Remote Incident Manager, allowing us to remote onto the computer and fix problems. It has the advantage that we can hear the audio output, so we are immediately able to understand what JAWS is saying which is essential for visually impaired people. At Hartgen Consultancy, we’re interested in listening – not looking.

As stated in the License Agreement, Technical Support to fix difficulties is free to individuals for a period of one Technical Support is available for a period of one year from the date of purchase. Please refer to our product License Agreement.

It is important that the computer on which J-Say and associated products are to be installed conforms to the following minimum specification, and that the software requirements are met.

  • 16GB of RAM. This is a minimum requirement.
  • All releases of Microsoft Windows 10 and Windows 11.
  • Microsoft Office. Office 365 is highly recommended!

  • Optionally, a high quality portable digital recorder for audio transcription. Please Contact Us! by Email or telephone to discuss which voice recorder would be suitable!
About the J-Say User Guide

The J-Say User Guide comprises three Books. The first Book consists of the “Installation Guide”, which gives you step by step detail on how to install your J-Say product. It goes onto describe the voice training enrolment process and how to configure the Windows operating system, associated applications and the J-Say software to perform optimally. Finally, the “Installation Guide” discusses the hardware and software which should be used to ensure you can get the most from the J-Say interface, all using non-technical language where possible and delivered from the perspective of visually impaired people wishing to install the product.

The second volume consists of a J-Say tutorial or “Learning Module”. The tutorial teaches you how to use J-Say with its many features, how you can work with non-supported applications and how you can educate the software to learn how you pronounce words and phrases. Again, the language used is not technical, delivered using step-by-step instructions.

The third book is the Command Summary which lists every voice command which can be spoken.

Working with J-Dictate and J-Say Training Course.

Introduction.

For 17 years, J-Say has provided visually impaired people not only with the means to be able to dictate text to the computer, (receiving meaningful speech feedback), but also it has delivered a vehicle for people who have physical and cognitive difficulties to take control of it using the human voice alone. This means that individuals with such challenges can work with traditional computing applications, providing independence to enhance communication with others, social media interaction, working with websites and more.

The software has allowed people to prepare and publish books, write plays and serials for radio and television, carry out all manner of employment tasks or, at a more basic level, send an Email to a family member in another country.

Over the years, we have attempted a range of training techniques for providing tuition in the use of J-Say. By far our most popular and successful method is face-to-face tuition. However during 2019 we’ve conducted a range of remote training sessions with people in the United States using the telephone. Some of those programmes are still ongoing.

However, it is not always easy to find cost effective training overseas in this very specialist area of computer access and control. Our new training course, developed and being made available in a new way, will assist with this.

How is the Course Delivered?

This course is delivered using a series of file modules in MP3 format with a current running time of close to 9 hours.

  • Creating a User Profile so Dragon can understand you.
  • Dictation and the effectiveness of microphone control.
  • Good practice when speaking to the computer.
  • Launching applications.
  • Text navigation.
  • Closing down the computer in the proper manner.
  • Backup of Voice Profiles and why this is critical.
  • Correcting Text.
  • The subtle differences between correction and erasure.
  • The effectiveness of the My Words feature.
  • Inserting and deleting text.
  • Selecting text using the J-Say Selection facility and Dragon NaturallySpeaking’s internal utilities.
  • Adjusting font styles, point size and text inconsistencies.
  • Acronyms and spelling words and phrases.
  • Working with Tables.
  • J-Say Shortcuts, Text Notes and Contacts.
  • Saving and opening documents.
  • Working with more than one application.
  • Proof Reading Strategies.
  • Working with Email. x
  • J-Clips.
  • Using J-Say on the Internet, working with forms, navigating tables, J-Say Alerts and J-Say Bookmarks.
  • J-Say Search.
  • The J-Say Wizard and how to use it.
  • Working with Facebook and Twitter. X
  • Adding words to the JAWS Dictionary.
  • Using non-supported applications. x
  • Restoring Voice Profiles. x

Course Prerequisites.

It is important that you have:

  • Dragon NaturallySpeaking version 13 or above;
  • J-Say version 14 through to 19. Note the higher the J-Say version you have, the more likely it is you will receive the best experience, since the product is being updated usually every two to three months
